importantTopics: Data Structure Basics and Algorithm Complexity
likelyQuestions: How is an array represented in memory? Differentiate row-major and column-major order and find the address of the given element.
Write an algorithm to insert a node at the end of a singly linked list; compare singly and circular linked lists.
Implement PUSH and POP on a stack using an array and analyse the complexity; list stack applications.
Define data structure; differentiate linear and non-linear data structures and discuss two in detail.
Differentiate a queue and a priority queue; implement a priority queue using linked lists.
Write insertion sort / selection sort with an example and analyse its complexity.
Write an algorithm for insertion at the end and deletion at the front of an array; list merits and demerits of array implementation of lists.
Write a program to reverse a circular linked list / return the nth element of a doubly linked list; list advantages and applications of linked lists.
Convert the given infix expression to prefix and postfix, and evaluate the given postfix expression using a stack.
Explain the complexity of algorithms and the time–space trade-off; give the time complexity of the given code segment.
